vulnerabilities.title: Self-assignable global portal privileges
vulnerabilities.evidence: ALL policy permits auth.uid own row with no field restriction; both pages call upsert.

vulnerabilities.title: Arbitrary vendor self-membership
vulnerabilities.evidence: INSERT WITH CHECK allows user_id=auth.uid without vendor constraint.
vulnerabilities.scenario: user inserts own membership for another vendor.
vulnerabilities.remediation: accepted invite or authorized membership operation only.

vulnerabilities.title: Role-, status-, brand-, and region-blind vendor management
vulnerabilities.evidence: helper checks only user/vendor row; RLS policies rely on it.
vulnerabilities.scenario: any membership manages an entire future portfolio.
vulnerabilities.remediation: active controlled role and scope helpers.

vulnerabilities.title: Public and unscoped manufacturer Storage authorization
vulnerabilities.evidence: public bucket; INSERT checks only bucket; UPDATE/DELETE check object owner rather than vendor authority.
vulnerabilities.scenario: authenticated user uploads arbitrary paths; public object exposure and vendor-control mismatch follow.
vulnerabilities.remediation: private bucket, verified vendor/asset paths, signed reads, and vendor-authorized mutation.

vulnerabilities.title: Non-authoritative manufacturer invitation acceptance
vulnerabilities.evidence: invite has no vendor FK/expiry/user binding; browser marks code accepted.
vulnerabilities.scenario: wrong account accepts or consumes an invitation code.
vulnerabilities.remediation: single-use expiring token acceptance bound to auth identity.

vulnerabilities.title: Training-card writes are not manufacturer-owned
vulnerabilities.evidence: organization membership is sufficient; policy does not test vendor ownership.
vulnerabilities.scenario: organization member edits a card for a brand they do not control.

vulnerabilities.title: Product and document writes lack manufacturer/brand scope
vulnerabilities.evidence: RLS uses CRM organization permissions only.
vulnerabilities.scenario: CRM manager modifies manufacturer content within organization but outside manufacturer authority.
vulnerabilities.remediation: add manufacturer/brand authorization for manufacturer-controlled records.
vulnerabilities.implementation_dependency: ownership backfill and content ownership model
vulnerabilities.validation_test: CRM-only actor cannot alter manufacturer-owned record

target_model.membership: extend mfr_members additively with controlled role, status(active/suspended/revoked/pending), accepted_invite_id, approved_by, approved_at, revoked_at; preserve historical rows
target_model.scopes: add additive membership scopes for brands, countries, capabilities, expiry and delegated principal; absence means explicit portfolio scope only for owner/admin
target_model.authorization: database RLS uses auth.uid plus active membership, role, brand and country; platform override is separately controlled
target_model.service: service role never reaches browser; privileged functions validate auth.uid, set explicit search_path, revoke anon/public execution and audit changes
